Could you please release the Nov 3 slot? We don't want to cancel the conversation completely, but we can park the demo and revisit in early Jan once the roadmap cycle resets. Priya will be my point on timing — I'll loop her in.

Apologies for the late notice and thanks for understanding.

Best,

alex.white@authoria.com

Alex — thanks for the update and totally understood. Please consider the Nov 3 slot released.

A couple quick items so we don't lose momentum:

- Marissa (CC) is our CS lead; I'll loop her for a light nurture plan so we keep the MAP intact and can pick back up without redoing discovery.
- If there's a specific stakeholder who will be back from travel in Jan, any ETA is helpful for timing.

We'll leave the MAP and demo artifacts on file; happy to do a short re-run when you have capacity.

Thanks again — and good luck with Q4 deliveries.

Best,
